fields.label: Owner
fields.description: User who owns the Job

fields.label: Id
fields.description: Job Id

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Job Name

fields.label: Interval
fields.description: The actual CRON definition using Vixie-style (POSIX).  Even if the user has chosen a predefined Interval Type like Hourly, a CRON definition is still created.

fields.label: Interval Type
fields.description: Informer Interval type:\nMinutes, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly or Custom

fields.label: Total Run Count
fields.description: The total number of times that this Job was run.  This is a field created by our aggregation run and is used to calculate the average runtime values.

fields.label: Total Run Seconds
fields.description: The total runtime in seconds of all the job runs.  This is a field created by our aggregation run and is used to calculate the average runtime values

fields.label: Mean Run Seconds
fields.description: The mathematical average calculated by dividing the total execution time across all runs by the run count. It offers a quick baseline of overall workload, though it can easily be distorted by extreme outliers such as sudden timeouts or aborted tasks. Use this alongside median to gauge overall skew.

fields.label: Median Run Seconds
fields.description: The middle execution time when all runs are arranged from fastest to slowest. Exactly half of all jobs complete faster than this mark, making it resistant to rare delays or early failures. It represents what users should expect as a truly typical runtime.

fields.label: Min Run Seconds
fields.description: The fastest run time in seconds

fields.label: Max Run Seconds
fields.description: The slowest run time in seconds

fields.label: Pct25 Run Seconds
fields.description: The runtime threshold that 25% of jobs finish within, representing the faster quarter of executions. It marks the lower boundary of normal operational speed. Runs completing faster than this are unusually swift or may have bypassed normal processing steps.

fields.label: Pct75 Run Seconds
fields.description: The runtime threshold within which 75% of runs successfully complete. It marks the upper boundary of typical operational behavior. If a job runs longer than this value, it is entering the slower quartile of executions.

fields.label: Pct90 Run Seconds
fields.description: The threshold under which 90% or 95% of all job runs finish. These metrics represent near-worst-case operational performance while filtering out total system freezes.

fields.label: Pct95 Run Seconds
fields.description: The threshold under which 90% or 95% of all job runs finish. These metrics represent near-worst-case operational performance while filtering out total system freezes.

fields.label: Std Dev Run Seconds
fields.description: The square root of variance, measuring how far run times typically stray from the mean in actual seconds. A low value indicates that execution times are tightly clustered and predictable. A high value indicates erratic runtime behavior across execution cycles.

fields.label: Last Run Date
fields.description: Last run date of this Job

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Is this job enabled if so, true

fields.label: Total Successful Runs
fields.description: Total number of successful runs
